# AI 客户经营 / AI Customer Lifecycle Management

> 免费公开、持续更新的开源书：当每个客户都值得被 AI 认真对待时，人做什么？

How should the full customer lifecycle be managed in the age of AI? Acquisition, Conversion, Service,
Retention, and Expansion — what the cases (starting with Klarna's two-year turn) and the evidence say,
plus what customer-operations teams need to change. 出处逐条可查：厂商标称与第三方报道分栏标注。

- 作者 / Author：Jweokk｜在线阅读 / Read online：https://ai-customer-growth.fly2ai.top
- 双语 / Languages：中文 11 章（站点 + `book/`）· English 11 chapters（`book-en/` + PDF）
- 许可 / License：非商业分享（正文 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0）；商用须书面许可
- 更新 / Updates：自动合并新素材持续增补，版本历史见附录 C / `CHANGELOG.md`
